learning: If S-bend and slalom line_loss_events stay at 1 with geometry fixed, the cause is not geometric and not bend speed. Next, test the start pose or a search direction. Record max_error and steering_oscillation to see whether the extra kd damps the overshoot.
notes: Geometry held at the iteration 5 values. Controller changes: kp 2.8, kd 0.25, base_speed 1.1, to test whether stronger, more damped correction at bend onset clears the S-bend and slalom line losses.
rationale: Iteration 5 showed that lowering base_speed from 1.3 to 1.2 left S-bend and slalom line loss at 1.0 event each, with max_error about 0.062 to 0.066 m. Oval loss stays at 0 with the plus or minus 0.05 m span. Geometry is held exactly at the iteration 5 values, as the Builder's intent and the feedback rules require, so this race isolates the controller. Speed reduction did not clear the losses, so entry speed alone is not the cause. I therefore make two controller changes: kp rises from 2.5 to 2.8 for a stronger correction at bend onset, and kd rises from 0.2 to 0.25 to damp the overshoot that follows. base_speed drops to 1.1 to give the correction more time per bend. line_loss stays at last_direction so the search-direction question is not confounded. The lost-line points on the S-bend and slalom remain unknown until the race reports where they start. Expected result: fewer or no S-bend and slalom line losses. If the losses persist, the next step is a start-pose or line_loss test, not a geometry edit. Score is expected near 53 to 56.
